moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-racing-credits, written here): Stage skewY −11.3° over a grid (verticals every 26 px grow down 0.05–0.45 s, +0.03 s per line from centre, power2.out; horizontals every 24 px). Accent bar 110 × 4 px races 200 → −420 px in 0.4 s linear from 0.5 s; role (15 px accent) slides 260 → 0 in 0.27 s linear from 0.6 s. Second bar −200 → 420 px from 0.85 s; name (32 px) −300 → 0 from 0.95 s. Role underline 0.87–1.1 s power2.out. Exit at the same speed, opposite ways, 3.2–3.36 s.
